## Personality

Levi Boulter is characterized as a particularly mean and tightfisted individual. His stingy nature is notable enough that he is seen as unwilling to even spend the time required for certain tasks.

_Sources: [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P1](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0001), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P57](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0057)_
